title: Tenma Tsukasa — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And now, put your hands together for my special show, “The Great Journey of Tsukasa Tenma”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Go Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Years ago on May 17th, a newborn cried for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Waaah! Waaah!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Oh, what a powerful and majestic cry! There's no doubt our child has a grand future ahead of him!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “You're right. He needs a name that screams 'ruler of the world'. Let's call him “Tsukasa”!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And thus begins the legacy of an aspiring star!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Legacy”? But he's still alive...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, I'm surprised to learn that his catchphrase is based on the actual origin of his name.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Huh? But Mom said that she didn't think about that meaning of his name at the time... Oh well.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Wow! Seeing the lead actor singing and dancing is enough to make everyone smile!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Someday...someday, I too...will become a star like him!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “A star who can make everyone smile, especially my little sister.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki told me about that. What a wonderful source of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And now, we arrive at Tsukasa Tenma's audition at Phoenix Wonderland! At this time, Tsukasa's younger sister Saki resumed her schooling!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite his concerns for her wellbeing, she was up on her feet in no time, forming a band with old friends and bubbling with lust for her new life!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “It's all thanks to Saki's vigor and her friends who are there to support her.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Even now, seeing her smiling with her friends fills me with warmth.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I could wish for nothing more than to see their everlasting joy.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And so, as he continued to chase his dreams, Tsukasa Tenma made some fantastic friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In spite of his own arrogance, misunderstandings and difficulties they faced, they turned out to be irreplaceable parts of his life.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “The path to stardom is long and seems endless, with nothing but dead end after dead end.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “But each time I've found myself at breaking point, they've always been there for me, their hands outstretched and their belief in me unwavering.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I need to prove them right in that belief. Therefore, I vow to become a star so bright that I'm known in every corner of the galaxy!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thus, a fire ignited within Tsukasa Tenma. He leaped forward, ready to embrace his unknown future. The end!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, that was amazing! I got a bit teary-eyed at one point!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! Let's keep making fun shows together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then, it's time to indulge ourselves in a hearty meal! I'd also like to hear your thoughts on the show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Om nom... Mmmh! This gratin is stuffed with lots of meat and macaroni! It's so tasty!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This perilla pasta is also really good, although the perilla leaves aren't cut properly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no, really? I was so careful when I was slicing them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, you even helped cook the food too, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well actually, me and Tsukasa made it together, with our mom there to show us how.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you and Tsukasa together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I could think of no better way to welcome my guests! We're confident that every dish will be to your liking!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's more, we even made a cake for dessert from scratch!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You did? That's impressive!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is, but isn't it a bit strange to make your own birthday cake?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's Tsukasa for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, thank you for all your help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This event wouldn't have gone as smoothly as it did if it wasn't for your help making the food and invites, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, glad I could be of help!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: After all, you're the one always helping me, so I just wanted you to have a fun birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Once again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gaaah! I must be... THE HAPPIEST OLDER BROTHER IN THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry for stopping by so early in the morning. Saki sent me a video of your Birthday Festival performance, and I watched it with Akito and the others.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When Toya mentioned it was a show about your life, I couldn't really picture how it would pan out, but I was really impressed by your delivery!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! It sounded like the biography of a great historical figure!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wouldn't go that far... But, we learned a lot about why you turned out the way you are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa, I intend to share my thoughts on the show in greater detail when we are at school. I hope you had a delightful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday Tsukasa♪ Ah... I could've gone to your party if it wasn't for work...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but Toya mentioned he'll show me a video of the show you performed, so I'll let you know how I found it later♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope you had a lovely birthday, Tsukasa. Shii sounded all excited telling me about your wonderful party. She mentioned the delicious food and the show, too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey... That's because you kept pestering me to tell you more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, it really was fun though, wasn't it? It was a great show, and we had delicious food to boot!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. It reminded me of the good old days. Saki, Tsukasa and everyone would gather 'round the table to eat together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right! Hehehe, I'm glad I got to help out! Here's to another year, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Although it was your birthday, we were the ones made to feel celebrated.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have to say, you delivered quite the show despite your busy rehearsal schedule. It made me wonder just how you managed to fit this in.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, although really, that show is still going on☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. Perhaps, when Tsukasa attains stardom someday, it will mean the show has ended.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If possible, I want to see that moment with my own eyes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too, and I won't fall behind him either.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh! Nene's all fired up! In that case, I'll give it my all, too♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, for now, we have plenty of shows on our plate. Here's to another year, Mr. Troupe Leader.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you everyone for celebrating my birthday today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your messages of support resonate within me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I promise to continue to race down the path to stardom!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hope you continue to look out for me. Thank you all for a magnificent day!
